trames-ipad.body:
Trames 1.5.4 consolidates the validated coordinator-removal work into the Mac and iPad stable channels, using shared runtime `eb047dc35351f8d9a623afd9325a6974adae47bb`.

- Task creation, exec/exit, original process-family completion, mount/namespace/credential controls, proc consumers, seccomp, BPF, memory barriers and entropy run through original shared resources on existing execution workers.
- The FD/network compatibility RPC and Unix ancillary owner-ledger/message-handoff categories are removed. Original descriptors survive close/reuse, cancellation, mixed SCM_RIGHTS transfer and final release without a separate execution service.
- Original console and epoll resources remain usable from source workers. Stream, datagram and seqpacket SIGPIPE behavior now matches native Linux, including partial stream batches.
- Release-gate corrections keep asynchronous ELF image loads live after a cohort returns, avoid proc fdinfo offset self-deadlock, and require a live console listener before reporting a restarted Mac environment ready.
- Stable and Dev keep independent app identities and storage. Environment contents are preserved during installation. Existing running environments adopt the new runtime when restarted.

The kernel owner is still present for explicit tracing, genuinely excluded resources, affected memory/backing checkpoints and actual host/session lifecycle. This release does not claim complete coordinator removal or a whole-browser speedup. Source-bound validation and the current boundary inventory are linked from the release acceptance record.

Mac packages are locally signed, unnotarized ARM64 builds, as in the previous stable release. iPad packages include the File Provider extension; the unsigned package must be signed with the installer's own app-group-capable profile. Any Personal Team signed IPA is restricted to the devices and expiry in its embedded development profiles; it is not an App Store or unrestricted distribution signature.


iPad release: version 1.5.4, build 49, ARM64 iPadOS 17 or later. The main app and File Provider extension have matching versions, shared-group metadata and verified signatures. DEBUG-only offline graphics test resources are excluded before the final app signature.

- `personal-team.ipa`: signed for the already registered development iPad only. The earliest embedded profile expires at **2026-11-10T17:05:14Z**. This is a Personal Team development signature, not general distribution.
- `unsigned.ipa`: generic app and File Provider identifiers, for signing with your own matching app-group-capable profiles.
- Corresponding source archive includes the exact iPad, Mac and shared runtime exports plus the original native dependency sources/patches/build recipes.

The physical iPad was offline during this release; no new on-device installation or UI acceptance is claimed. Device release linking/signing, simulator target compilation, host model tests and shared Linux/HVF/interpreter acceptance are recorded separately in the verification report.

Trames 1.3.0（build 35），面向 iPad 的正式更新。

- 修复大块虚拟内存预留挤走普通堆映射、拖慢内存释放的问题。
- 增加硬 MMU 稀疏地址别名容量，减少多进程场景的软件回退；虚拟预留不预分配物理 RAM。
- 完善原生 Vulkan/GLES3、Transform Feedback、窗口重绘和 resize 边界，包含当前 Xwayland GPU、剪贴板及输入适配。
- 复用源码未变的通过结果；直接发布本次已编译构建，不重复运行整套验收。

Firefox：同配置低刷新率诊断中，旧版关闭约 98 秒后被自身 watchdog 终止，新版约 34 秒正常退出；使用包内 musl 的对齐检查约 39 秒正常退出。默认刷新率在 Linux CPU Vulkan 参考环境仍有重绘/交互拥塞，[Issue #33](https://github.com/kb5000/trames/issues/33) 保持开放。本版本尚未完成物理 iPad 上的 Firefox 验收，未内置诊断偏好或原始诊断数据。

下载 `Trames-1.3.0-build35-unsigned.ipa`，在 Windows 上使用 Sideloadly 签名安装。File Provider 的 App Group 能力仍需正式签名环境验收。

项目使用 GPLv3；本 Release 同时提供项目源码及 musl、Vulkan 原生依赖、Mesa、Xwayland 的对应源码和校验清单。

Trames 1.2.0 / build 33 增加基础 Wayland EGL/GLES2 的 Zink 原生 GPU 窗口链路，并包含近期运行效率优化。

- Linux ARM64 应用通过 Mesa Zink → Vulkan loader → Trames ICD → MoltenVK/Metal 呈现到现有浮窗/标签页。正常呈现直接使用 GPU 图像。
- 保留原版 Gallium/Zink/NIR/GLSL/SPIR-V/GLES2；仅给 Mesa 25.1.9 EGL 增加最小的无 DRM Kopper 平台适配。开启 Vulkan/GPU 后自动安装标准 `libEGL.so.1`，保留 apk 管理的 Mesa 文件。
- Vulkan 增加真实图像复制、查询/描述符/同步与渲染资源支持，目前共172个公开入口；修复交换链采样、调整大小时的复制及 GPU 内存选择问题。
- Linux 与 Apple Metal 的两轮双窗口、调整大小、最小化/还原、关闭、重启及旧帧保活通过；Apple 校验全部导出纹理像素。
- 优化通用目录查找、目录枚举及单线程调度路径，减少 Docker 启动等场景的额外开销。不包含 JIT。

下载 unsigned IPA 后用 Windows Sideloadly 签名安装。沿用相同 Apple ID 和有效 bundle ID 可保留数据。需要图形功能时开启应用里的 Vulkan/GPU 开关；Linux 内按需安装 `mesa-dri-gallium mesa-egl mesa-gles vulkan-loader wayland-libs-egl`。

目前是基础 GLES2 和受限 Vulkan profile，并非完整 OpenGL/Vulkan 一致性认证；更多格式、mipmap、高版本 GL 和渲染状态仍在逐步补齐。Mesa ES2 当前使用上游 `mesa_glthread=false` 配置。保留原有 Docker/容器兼容边界，File Provider 激活仍需正式 App Group 签名。

已通过的源码相同项目直接复用，本版重新编译优化的 ARM64 iPad Release 应用。Apple CI 使用 Paravirtual Metal；本版物理 iPad 运行及性能由后续真机测试确认。提供 GPLv3、上游许可证，以及对应的项目、musl、MoltenVK 和 Mesa EGL 源码/补丁；历史 Release 与 tag 不修改。

Trames 1.1.0 / build 32 将 guest 内 Docker 支持和最近的兼容性修复合入正式版。

- 默认 `dockerd → containerd → runc`，使用 overlay2；无需外部 containerd、crun、GOMAXPROCS 或专用 nofile 参数。
- guest 网络/IPC/cgroup namespace、veth/bridge、DNS、filter/conntrack/NAT、TCP/UDP 发布和网络隔离；overlay2 延迟复制、whiteout、持久化与重启。
- 修正交互式容器的 devpts inode 和 O_PATH/proc 设备重新打开，原版 `docker run -it --rm` 的终端输入、输出和退出通过验证。
- iPad 会话启动时自动挂载 `/run` 和 `/dev/shm`，先于 Wayland、终端及服务。
- 限制 MMU 可选别名窗口的宿主虚拟地址占用，保留按需物理分配与 guest 4 GiB 配置；修正 `route -n` 地址/掩码字节序。
- 优化 proc maps 重复遍历和 16 KiB 页组的软件回退准备。开发机测量不代表 iPad 性能保证。

解压/下载 unsigned IPA 后用 Sideloadly 签名安装。延续相同 Apple ID 和有效 bundle ID 可保留原有数据。File Provider 真机激活仍需正式 App Group 签名。

这是已验证范围内的 rootful guest Docker；完整 OCI、rootless、资源控制器、CRI/Kubernetes、BuildKit/Compose、全部 Registry/volume/TTY 行为仍在跟踪。交互式验收确认 Docker API 中自动删除容器，日志中的 shim 清理警告仍保留。iPad 实际性能、后台/前台网络和当前修复的真机验收不冒充 CI 结果。

沿用已验证且源码未变的 UI、CPU 差分、GPU 和 guest 库证据；本版另做 Linux/Apple Rust 工作区总检查和当前 ARM64 Release 应用编译。保留 GPLv3、上游许可证、对应 musl/MoltenVK 源码及本版本项目源码归档。历史 Release 和 tag 不修改。

Trames 1.0.0 支持在 iPad 中同时使用多个本地 Alpine 终端和 Wayland 窗口。

- 点击 **+ → 本地 Alpine 终端**，每次新建一个独立 shell／PTY。所有终端共享同一套 Linux 文件、进程、网络和已安装软件，工作目录、环境变量及终端尺寸各自独立。支持浮动、调整大小、最小化回标签页、停靠和关闭；关闭首个终端或全部终端后再打开，Linux 环境继续保留。
- 宿主原生 Wayland 合成器与 Vulkan／Metal 显示，图形窗口和终端共用工作区。包含 GTK／mousepad seat、右键复制、方向键后输入和跨 App 文本剪贴板修复；iPadOS 读取权限等待期间不再积累重复粘贴。
- 系统 App 最大化／还原刷新真实终端和 PTY 尺寸，后台恢复保留 vkcube 偏好位置；原始 SwiftTerm 扩展键盘与系统调整角落留出间距，状态行和两秒 CPU 采样保留。原版 foot 可运行，固定大小对话框和 Files 重复导入已适配。
- 保留只读 File Provider 的 Trames → Alpine → rootfs 结构及多 rootfs 扩展空间。它仍需要正式 App Group 签名；免费侧载可继续使用 App 内 Files 导入／导出，正式签名后的设备验收尚未完成。

下载 `Trames-1.0.0-build26-unsigned.ipa`，在 Windows 或 Mac 上使用 Sideloadly 签名安装。当前包未签名。GPU 功能仍为实验性功能，在设置中启用；具体应用兼容性受已实现的 Vulkan／Wayland 协议与 Linux 系统调用范围限制。

GPL-3.0-or-later。Release 同时提供 IPA 摘要、构建验证记录，以及配套的 musl 和 Vulkan 原始源码归档；完整 Trames 对应源码位于同一 Release tag。

0.17.0/build 19 加入宿主原生 Wayland 合成器、统一窗口与标签页，以及更完整的 Vulkan 图形支持。

Windows 下载 `Trames-0.17.0-build19-unsigned.ipa`，用 Sideloadly、原 Apple ID 和实际 Bundle ID 覆盖安装可保留数据。最低 iPadOS 17，原 Bundle ID 为 `org.trames.Trames`。

- 原版 Linux Wayland 应用各自显示为 App 内小窗，支持移动、调整大小、最小化、关闭与停靠。调整大小会请求客户端重新生成对应分辨率的图像。终端与图形应用共用顶部标签栏，可拖出为浮窗、拖回停靠或重排；旧“显示窗口”菜单和固定分辨率显示器界面已移除。
- UIKit 原生输入桥接 text-input v1/v3，支持预编辑、中文、emoji、选择和光标状态。修复 Weston editor 切换文本框不取消原激活状态、图形窗口抢占终端键盘，以及空 OSC 标题使 Alpine 标签变空的问题。
- 标准 `VK_KHR_wayland_surface` 把原生 Vulkan 图像直接交给 Metal 合成，常规显示不读回像素。共享 SHM 图像优先直接导入，复制回退单独计数；资源保持到生产者与最终显示完成。支持 FIFO 与 Mailbox 各自的队列和图像复用语义。
- 原版 vkmark 所需的原生采样各向异性、D32 深度、静态／动态视口和裁剪、颜色／alpha 混合及传输清屏已补齐。原版 vkcube、Weston 客户端与 vkmark 无需修改。Vulkan 仍需在设置中开启，重新打开本地终端后生效。
- Linux 总内存与单进程预算可在 App 设置中配置，默认 1 GiB／512 MiB，按需使用。并行内存映射改为增量维护，加入 inotify；真实 Node `fs.watch` 与 code-server 的兼容性验证继续推进，完整 code-server 编辑体验尚未作为本版承诺。
- 解释器加入硬件保护的 RAM 直通映射与单级缓存；特殊映射保留原有处理。修复开启 Vulkan 后第二次启动的 `virtual filesystem errno 17`。继续使用无 JIT 的 ARM64 CPU 解释器；GPU 着色器由原生驱动编译。

这是选定 Wayland／Vulkan 接口的实现，尚非完整一致性支持；剪贴板与拖放、自定义鼠标图像、自动响应式弹窗布局及 OpenGL／EGL 桥接未包含。模拟器的程序化输入与画面验证不等同于真机触控和系统输入法候选体验。

窗口使用见 `docs/guides/wayland.md`，验证范围见 `docs/validation/wayland-workspace-vkmark.md`。本轮原版 vkmark 的短场景仅做功能验收，不作为性能成绩。

0.16.0/build 17 合并 guest 内容器、宿主直连网络和通用解释器优化，继续使用无 JIT 的 ARM64 执行器。

Windows 下载 `Trames-0.16.0-build17-unsigned.ipa`，使用 Sideloadly 和原 Apple ID、实际 Bundle ID 覆盖安装。最低 iPadOS 17，原 Bundle ID 为 `org.trames.Trames`。

- Guest 内容器：UTS／mount／PID namespace、chroot／pivot_root、bind／tmpfs、选定 capabilities、cgroup v2、设备节点与过滤、signalfd 和 Unix socket／SCM_RIGHTS。原版 Alpine crun 与 Docker → containerd → crun 的导入、create/start、退出码、日志和清理通过限定配置验收。
- 默认网络改为宿主直连 TCP／UDP 和系统 DNS，逻辑 eth0 展示活动宿主地址。普通流量不再经过 10.0.0.1 网关；应用监听实际宿主 socket，端口访问受 iOS 权限、路由和生命周期约束。
- 通用执行优化：借用已解码指令、延迟计算算术 C/V 标志、编译器保证的显式尾调用、缓存访存权限的软 TLB，以及协调线程的本地 COW。使用固定 nightly 工具链，设备 App 与 Rust 核心按 Release 配置构建。
- 保留原有 sudo、时区、匿名 ELF／execveat、Vulkan／Metal 计算、纹理与浮动显示窗口。Vulkan 与实验性原生 malloc/free 的默认开关沿用原配置。

Docker 当前使用 vfs、guest 根网络、共享 IPC/cgroup namespace 和关闭 seccomp 的选定配置，无需 `--privileged`。没有实现独立容器网络、overlayfs 或完整资源控制；pull/build/Compose/rootless 等未完成验收。使用方法见仓库 `docs/guides/guest-docker.md`。冷启动仍较慢。

覆盖安装可保留数据，但磁盘元数据由 v3 自动升级为 v4，以保存扩展属性与新的 inode 类型。旧版本无法读取 v4；升级前请导出重要文件，不要通过覆盖回旧版降级同一磁盘。

本轮未转正的整数块、固定寄存器驻留与固定槽位融合实验仅保留为源码补丁和测量记录，未纳入默认执行路径。性能数据来自共享开发机，不能直接等同于 iPad 提速；物理 iPad、Safari/LAN 访问和前后台行为仍需实际验收。

0.15.0/build 16 合并 sudo／时区／匿名 ELF 兼容修复，以及原生 Vulkan 计算、图形、纹理与 App 内显示窗口。仍不使用 guest CPU JIT。

Windows 下载 `Trames-0.15.0-build16-unsigned.ipa`，交给 Sideloadly 签名。沿用原 Apple ID 和实际 Bundle ID 覆盖安装可保留 Linux 数据；最低 iPadOS 17，原 Bundle ID 为 `org.trames.Trames`。

- 原版 sudo 的伪终端、密码认证、提权与嵌套运行；同步 iPad 时区规则并保留显式 TZ。
- 修复 `/proc/self/fd/N` 匿名／已删除文件执行，加入 `execveat`、`AT_EMPTY_PATH`、`O_PATH`；Python memfd 与 pass_fds 测试通过。
- 默认关闭的 Vulkan 实验开关：原版 Linux loader → guest ICD → 原版 MoltenVK 1.4.2／Metal。108 个选定入口支持计算、顶点／索引缓冲、纹理上传与采样、图形描述符和 push constants。
- 标准 display/surface/swapchain 直接向 App 内画布提交 GPU 图像；窗口可拖动、调整大小、隐藏和恢复，画布保持 1024×768。终端菜单可重新显示窗口。
- 固定 NIOSSH 源码修复通道关闭期间的窗口调整崩溃。

原版 MoltenVK 的 iOS 模拟器不支持非零 base vertex/instance；基础索引／实例绘制单独验收，非零偏移在 Linux 原生驱动上验证。Vulkan 是选定子集，仍缺少深度／混合、多 mip、桌面窗口协议与指针输入。原生 Metal 证据来自 iPad 模拟器，物理 iPad 验收与性能仍需实际使用确认；本版不宣称整体提速。实验性原生 malloc/free 继续默认关闭。

trames-mac.body:
Trames 1.5.4 consolidates the validated coordinator-removal work into the Mac and iPad stable channels, using shared runtime `eb047dc35351f8d9a623afd9325a6974adae47bb`.

- Task creation, exec/exit, original process-family completion, mount/namespace/credential controls, proc consumers, seccomp, BPF, memory barriers and entropy run through original shared resources on existing execution workers.
- The FD/network compatibility RPC and Unix ancillary owner-ledger/message-handoff categories are removed. Original descriptors survive close/reuse, cancellation, mixed SCM_RIGHTS transfer and final release without a separate execution service.
- Original console and epoll resources remain usable from source workers. Stream, datagram and seqpacket SIGPIPE behavior now matches native Linux, including partial stream batches.
- Release-gate corrections keep asynchronous ELF image loads live after a cohort returns, avoid proc fdinfo offset self-deadlock, and require a live console listener before reporting a restarted Mac environment ready.
- Stable and Dev keep independent app identities and storage. Environment contents are preserved during installation. Existing running environments adopt the new runtime when restarted.

The kernel owner is still present for explicit tracing, genuinely excluded resources, affected memory/backing checkpoints and actual host/session lifecycle. This release does not claim complete coordinator removal or a whole-browser speedup. Source-bound validation and the current boundary inventory are linked from the release acceptance record.

Mac packages are locally signed, unnotarized ARM64 builds, as in the previous stable release. iPad packages include the File Provider extension; the unsigned package must be signed with the installer's own app-group-capable profile. Any Personal Team signed IPA is restricted to the devices and expiry in its embedded development profiles; it is not an App Store or unrestricted distribution signature.


Download the stable Mac ARM64 archive; the Dev archive uses a separate identity. Both are unnotarized local builds. Archives include the exact application/runtime sources and native MoltenVK sources, and new logo assets. Existing environments are preserved; a running environment adopts the new runtime after restart.

Fixes large HTTP responses and intermittent Go/Docker hangs.

- TCP stream writes larger than the existing staging bound now make progress through short writes; datagram atomic-size errors are preserved.
- Interrupted/exiting futex waits retire their logical registration even while an owner checkpoint retains a clone. This prevents stale tickets from stealing later wakes and stranding Go GC or Docker operations.
- No coordinator/service thread or Go async-preemption workaround is introduced.

Local acceptance: Apple and ARM Linux ABI/network/kernel checks, strict Clippy, Mac workflow and iPad FFI target compile. The original Python sendall reproducer transfers all 3,777,458 bytes. Stock Debian Go GC stress passes at 4/12 CPUs, and both the test build and final stable binary pass eight isolated Docker lifecycle cycles. The installed Debian deployment also passes full-response and Docker health checks after restart.

Stable and Dev have separate app identities and data registries. Both ARM64 packages are locally signed and unnotarized, following the selected distribution method. Each package includes the paired product/runtime sources and native-driver corresponding sources. Existing environments must restart to load the corrected runtime. Installation preserves their storage.

Trames Mac 1.5.2 fixes concurrent runc startup and includes the event-wait, timer and signal work completed after 1.5.1.

## Fixes and changes

- Remove an incorrect global 128-entry mount-resource quota. Independent namespaces no longer exhaust each other's allowance during bootstrap. Per-namespace mount bounds and resource retirement remain. This fixes a reproduced nsexec ENOSPC → final-child PID-pipe EOF failure chain.
- Support cross-process `prlimit64` for namespace-visible PIDs and TIDs. Check the caller's authority and memory, update the target process's limits shared by its threads, preserve independent fork copies and enforce the changed FD limit. Stock runc can now apply its default explicit nofile limit to its init child.
- Complete admitted event waits and temporary signal masks on their source workers, retaining the original descriptors and wake sources across waits.
- Run POSIX and real interval timers through the existing execution workers and shared deadline resources.
- Share signal queues, controls and reader-scoped waits across workers, including ordinary sends, masks/actions, sigwait/sigsuspend and signalfd reads. Lifecycle/default stop/termination, structural namespaces and resource-policy mutation still retain their documented owner boundaries. No new coordinator/service thread is introduced.

## Validation

All 12 Mac workflow shell steps pass locally, including strict workspace checks, product tests, native task-stream acceptance and stable/dev build/package checks. Separate integration tests pass for stable/dev install isolation, CLI PATH, structured exec, signals, independent shells and lifecycle. Every packaged member checksum and ZIP integrity is verified; packaged binaries and logos match the installed apps.

Apple and native ARM Linux each pass 290 kernel-conformance tests (three ignored) and 17 kernel unit tests. Strict shared checks, paired dependency boundaries and the iPad device-target compile pass. Unchanged VFS/ABI, graphics and network results from the preceding validated migrations are reused.

A real static-musl probe reproduces ESRCH on the old Dev runtime and passes on native ARM Linux, HVF at 1/4/12 CPUs and the shared interpreter at 1/4 CPUs. It verifies parent-to-child and parent-to-thread limit updates, thread sharing, actual EMFILE enforcement, an unchanged caller and ESRCH after reaping. Original runc 1.1.15+ds1-2+b4 completes 72 concurrent starts with its default explicit RLIMIT_NOFILE 1024/1024: Dev at 4/12 CPUs and stable at 12 CPUs. The isolated pressure test uses three rounds of eight starts and 32 empty tmpfs mounts, with no application data or external API workload.

## Downloads and upgrade

- `Trames-1.5.2-mac-arm64-unnotarized.zip`: stable app and `trames` CLI.
- `Trames-Dev-1.5.2-mac-arm64-unnotarized.zip`: separate development app and `trames-dev` CLI.
- Each includes a SHA-256 file, installer, guide, paired product/runtime source exports and the unchanged native-driver corresponding-source bundle.

The apps are locally signed, **not notarized or Developer ID signed**, retaining the selected distribution method. Stable and Dev keep separate environment registries. Environment data lives outside the app and survives installation. Existing environments were not restarted during installation and remain healthy; stop and start an environment when convenient to load the new runtime.

Trames Mac 1.5.1 fixes a Debian Docker overlay deadlock and includes the worker-owned transfer subsystem developed after 1.5.0.

## Fixes and changes

- Fix a filesystem/inode lock inversion during overlay rename/checkpoint and file-epoch stat preparation. A container `useradd` could otherwise freeze all guest exec requests.
- Correct the related directory-stat and overlay copy-up lock order, retain immutable mount device identity, and remove recursive filesystem read acquisition from two import/hard-link limit checks. No global lock or coordinator thread is added.
- Run admitted `sendfile`/`splice` file, pipe, Unix-stream and TCP transfers on their calling workers. Backpressure parks only the source task; native disk jobs reuse the existing pool. Preserve original descriptors across waits, offsets, EOF, SIGPIPE and signal restart.
- Keep fast, immediately completing joined transfers on the original VFS. Native completion wakes the source directly rather than falling through fixed sleep polling.

Four-worker 4-KiB transfer microbenchmarks improve approximately 15–42x with memory backing and 2.6–9.8x with private storage versus 1.5.0. These are bounded subsystem benchmarks, not Firefox or whole-application speedups. The shared runtime and tests also remain iPad-compatible.

## Validation

Local Mac CI checks, all product tests, native task-stream/manager fixtures and both stable/dev build/package checks pass. Shared Apple/Linux validation covers 281 kernel, 228 Linux ABI and 463 VFS cases per platform, including separately run final additions and existing ignored tests. Strict checks, paired dependency boundaries and the iPad device-target compile pass; unchanged suites are reused.

The original unmodified Docker useradd repro passes repeatedly in an APFS clone of the frozen Debian environment. The final stable binary also passes that repro and a BuildKit build containing groupadd, useradd and Python SSL/urllib imports, followed by a fresh environment exec probe. The forced-lock regression correctly fails with the old device-lock path and passes with the fix. The installed stable app also passes the original repro in the recovered original Debian environment; the separate nginx container and its persistent volume survive the upgrade/restart. Remote Mac CI passes for the release commit.

## Downloads and upgrade

- `Trames-1.5.1-mac-arm64-unnotarized.zip`: stable app and `trames` CLI.
- `Trames-Dev-1.5.1-mac-arm64-unnotarized.zip`: separate development app and `trames-dev` CLI.
- Each has a SHA-256 file, installer, guide, paired product/runtime source exports and the unchanged native-driver source bundle.

The apps are locally signed, **not notarized or Developer ID signed**, retaining the previously selected distribution method. Stable and development environment registries remain separate. Environment data is outside the app and survives installation. Restart running environments once to load the new runtime.

Trames Mac 1.5.0 provides persistent Linux environments and a Unix-style CLI on Apple Silicon using the shared Trames userspace Linux kernel.

## Downloads

- `Trames-1.5.0-mac-arm64-unnotarized.zip`: stable application and `trames` CLI.
- `Trames-Dev-1.5.0-mac-arm64-unnotarized.zip`: isolated development application and `trames-dev` CLI.
- SHA-256 files accompany both downloads. Each package contains its installer, English guide and paired product/runtime source archives.

These builds are locally signed and **not notarized or Developer ID signed**. They retain the previously selected distribution method. Existing environment data lives outside the app and is preserved by installation.

## Changes

- Persistent background environments with independent interactive terminals, session listing and detach/reattach.
- Structured `exec`: literal argv, separate binary stdin/stdout/stderr, environment and working-directory options, opt-in PTY, command exit status and scoped process-group signals.
- Scoped environment/global configuration, shell completion and an explicit Finder GUI entry.
- New environments default to all available CPU cores, Vulkan enabled and host-managed memory (`auto`). Existing environment settings remain unchanged.
- Alpine, Debian, optional systemd, custom ARM64 rootfs, private/shared storage, backup/restore and login autostart.
- Real Debian Docker/containerd/runc and a persistent nginx container validated with overlay2, systemd and cgroup v2. Resource controllers and complete Linux-kernel compatibility are not claimed.

## CLI migration

`trames env start NAME` now starts in the background and returns. Use `trames -e NAME shell` for each interactive terminal, or `trames -e NAME exec -- COMMAND ARGS...` for scripts. Shell/exec never implicitly download or create an environment. Noninteractive bare `trames` prints help; use `trames gui` for the manager.

Settings are saved without implicit package installation and take effect after restart. Use `trames env setup NAME --init systemd` to provision systemd on an existing stopped Debian environment. Restart previously running environments once to load the new exec endpoint.

## Validation

Local Mac CI checks and both packaging checks pass; the GitHub Mac workflow also passed for the release commit. Focused real-HVF acceptance covers binary full-duplex transfer, concurrent exec, exit codes/signals, independent terminals, scoped configuration, generic rootfs, launcher/PATH migration, backup/restore and stable/dev isolation. Existing Debian/systemd Docker service and volume data survived upgrade/restart. The common interpreter kernel suite passed 280 cases (3 intentional ignores), and the iPad device-target compatibility check passed. This is not a new physical-iPad release.
